title: 10x is forwarding everything it reads
description: Alerts when, over the last hour, the bytes the 10x Engine forwarded equal the bytes it read, which means no per-pattern decision is reducing what reaches Datadog.

definition.name: [log10x] No reduction on {{tenx_env.name}}
definition.message:
In `{{tenx_env.name}}`, the 10x Engine forwarded every byte it read over the last hour.

To resolve:
1. Check the engine's receive configuration for the rate and compact receivers
2. Confirm the per-pattern policy the engine loaded is the one intended for this environment
